description: Simulate an asteroid impact: energy, air burst or crater, radii of blast, heat and earthquake effects, effects felt at a chosen distance, and how often such an object hits Earth (Collins, Melosh & Marcus 2005). Use it for 'what if' questions; for real asteroids passing today use neo_watch. Local model, no network call.

angle_deg.description: Entry angle from the horizontal in degrees (5-90, default 45).

density_kg_m3.description: Density in kg/m³: 1500 cometary ice, 3000 stony rock (default), 8000 iron.

diameter_m.description: Asteroid diameter in metres (1-30000). Required unless a preset is given.

distance_km.description: Effects felt at this distance from impact

preset.description: Known event that fills the parameters: tcheliabinsk (2013), toungouska (1908), apophis, chicxulub.

name: asteroid_impact

outputSchema.description: Returns regime, energy_mt_tnt, hiroshima_equivalent, burst_altitude_km or crater_diameter_km, earthquake_magnitude, zones_radius_km, at_distance, average_interval_years.

title: Asteroid impact simulator
